helper_audit.name: area_matrix
helper_audit.reason: For a*a-b*c=1 and 1+a!=0, k=b/(1+a) satisfies c*k=a-1 and k*(1+a)=b. The checked equality M=U(k) composed L(c) composed U(k) has diagonal 1+c*k=a, lower c and upper k*(1+a)=b. Each actual factor preserves volume. These determinant/denominator premises are private and discharged by harmonic coefficients.

helper_audit.name: harmonic_linear
helper_audit.reason: eta>0 gives sqrt(eta)!=0. Coefficients are exactly a=cos u,b=sqrt(eta)*sin u,c=-sin u/sqrt(eta); field simplification and sin^2+cos^2=1 discharge area_matrix. If 1+cos u=0, cos u=-1 forces sin u=0 and the actual map equals negate_phase. No exceptional duration is dropped; no unscaled isometry claim.
